Department of Neurology, Huadong Hospital, Fudan University, SHANGHAI 200040, China)[ABSTRACT] Modafinil is a potent wake-promoting agent. It is used for improving the excessive daytime sleepiness associated with narcolepsy, shift work sleep disorder and residual sleepiness in obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) despite optimal use of continuous positive airway pressure. Other clinical indications were reported, but further confirmation is needed. In vivo, modafinil has been shown to induce CYP3A4 activity and it is also metabolised by CYP3A4. There is the possibility of interactions between modafinil and the drugs that are metabolised by CYP3A4 or that inhibit or induce the enzyme.莫达非尼（modafinil）为一种促觉醒药，与传统精神兴奋药不同，它的觉醒作用强大。
